//: Justification manifest for every pnpm override in pnpm-workspace.yaml. This is the single source of truth: scripts/__tests__/pnpm-workspace-config.test.mjs enforces a 1:1 mapping (every override has an entry here and vice-versa) and that each `override` value matches the pin in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Adding an override without a dated, CVE-annotated entry here fails CI. category A = the declaring parent forbids the fixed version (out-of-range force); category B = the fix is in-range but pnpm resolves a vulnerable version without the pin (an override is pnpm's only lever to bump a deep transitive). Remove an entry when its parent ships a release carrying the fix — test with `node scripts/audit-overrides.mjs`, NEVER by deleting the pin and running a plain `pnpm install`: pnpm does not downgrade an already-satisfying locked version, so a category B pin always looks redundant against an existing lockfile whether or not it is. The optional `scannerInvisible` field marks a pin whose justification OSV cannot see: such a pin is REQUIRED despite scanning clean, so the audit never tests it for removal and reports it PROTECTED. A LOAD-BEARING verdict therefore names the only scanner-VISIBLE required pin, never the only required pin. Ten entries were pruned on 2026-08-07 after a from-scratch lockfile refresh made them inert, each verified individually by the audit. See docs/internal/dependency-overrides.md.

gray-matter>js-yaml.reason: js-yaml merge-key quadratic DoS (fixed 4.2.0) and !!omap quadratic DoS (fixed 4.3.1; raised from ^4.2.0 on 2026-08-07 because the old floor still admitted the vulnerable 4.3.0). gray-matter declares ^3.x; paired with patchedDependencies gray-matter@4.0.3 (safeLoad/safeDump -> load/dump). The patched 3.x (3.15.1) is not a viable target: load() is the safe schema only on 4.x, so a 3.x resolution would make the patched call the full/unsafe loader.

@istanbuljs/load-nyc-config>js-yaml.reason: js-yaml merge-key quadratic DoS (fixed 4.2.0) and !!omap quadratic DoS (fixed 4.3.1; raised from ^4.2.0 on 2026-08-07 because the old floor still admitted the vulnerable 4.3.0). @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config declares ^3.x but already uses load(), so it needs only the override (no patch) — and still needs 4.x, where load() is the safe schema.

It calls load() unconditionally (index.js:80); on 3.x that is the full/unsafe loader rather than the safe schema, so a 3.x resolution silently widens what a .nycrc.yml can construct while OSV reports clean. Never remove on a clean scan alone.

qs.reason: qs stringify DoS. Without the pin, resolution picks the vulnerable 6.15.1 — re-proven 2026-08-07 by `node scripts/audit-overrides.mjs`, the only pin the audit rates LOAD-BEARING under a from-scratch resolve. That verdict is a claim about scanner visibility, not about necessity: it ranges only over the pins the audit tests, since LOAD-BEARING means removal makes OSV fail. The three `scannerInvisible` js-yaml pins are never tested (reported PROTECTED) and are just as required — each entry states its own reason. Dependency-reachable via packages/mcp -> @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> express -> qs, but NOT code-reachable: packages/mcp/src/index.ts connects only StdioServerTransport, and the SDK's express/hono surface lives behind the server/streamableHttp.js and server/auth/** subpaths, which nothing in packages/*/src imports (verified 2026-08-07). Pinned anyway — the pin is free, and an HTTP transport would activate the path.
